references.text: The Salt Sea (Dead Sea) is mentioned as a geographical landmark, the same eastern boundary described in Numbers 34:3
The Wilderness of Zin is mentioned as part of Israel's territory, the same wilderness that forms the southern border
Judah's southern border is described with the same geographical reference points: Edom, the Wilderness of Zin, and the Salt Sea
The cities in Judah's southern region toward the border of Edom, which coincide with the southern border described here
Ezekiel's vision of the land's borders includes the southern border from Tamar to Meribath-Kadesh, along the border of Edom
The kings and chiefs of Edom are mentioned, and Edom is the neighboring country that forms the border to the south
Israel's journey along the border of Edom is described, which is the same border area mentioned in Numbers 34:3
